purpose: Bulk DE agreement with DESeq2 1.48.2 on GTEx thyroid with Cook's-distance filtering disabled in both tools (docs/BULK_DE.md, larger multi-factor designs)

commands.rapidglm: rapidglm bulk-de with cooks_filter=false, coefficient sex[T.female]
commands.deseq2: DESeq(full = design, betaPrior = FALSE) then results(name = 'sex.T.female.', cooksCutoff = FALSE)

alpha_rob_black_box.method: alpha_rob = ((y-mu)^2/R^2 - mu)/mu^2 with R^2 = D p (1-h)^2/h from DESeq2's cooks, mu and H assays
